controles.affirmation: Plus de 18 000 poursuites AFFF contre Carrier, Kidde-Fenwal et RTX
controles.verbatim_source: the Company, Kidde-Fenwal, Inc. ("KFI") and others have been named as defendants in more than 18,000 lawsuits filed in United States state or federal courts and a single case in Canada

controles.affirmation: L'accord AFFF (Estate Claims Settlement) est en cours d'approbation mais son montant n'est mentionne nulle part dans le 10-Q
controles.verbatim_source: As part of the Proposed Settlement Agreements, the Company will pay $615 million in cash over five years, 100% of the net sale proceeds from its sale of KFI's assets to Pacific Avenue Capital Partners, which are estimated to be $115 million... As a result of the Proposed Settlement Agreements, the Company recorded a liability in the amount of $565 million during 2024.
controles.correction_proposee: Le 10-Q chiffre l'accord : 615 M$ en cash sur cinq ans, ~115 M$ de produit net de cession de KFI, et une provision de 565 M$ comptabilisee en 2024 (plus 50 M$ en 2023). Supprimer l'affirmation d'absence de chiffrage.

controles.affirmation: La societe se declare incapable d'evaluer la probabilite d'un passif ou d'estimer une fourchette de perte (AFFF)
controles.verbatim_source: the Company is unable to assess the probability of liability or to reasonably estimate a range of possible loss at this time
controles.correction_proposee: Preciser que cette phrase vise les "remaining AFFF claims", pas l'exposition deja provisionnee.

controles.affirmation: Recours collectifs antitrust HVAC depuis mars 2026 devant le tribunal federal du Michigan, dommages triples, exposition non estimable
controles.verbatim_source: Beginning in March 2026... United States District Court for the Eastern District of Michigan... an unlawful agreement to fix or raise the prices of certain HVAC products in the United States since January 1, 2020. The lawsuits seek damages, including treble damages... the Company is unable to assess the probability of liability

controles.affirmation: Depreciation de 46 M$ sur Riello, activite "en cours de cession" ; actifs/passifs destines a la cession 815 M$ et 414 M$
controles.verbatim_source: The Company recognized an impairment charge of $46 million... during the three months ended June 30, 2026. The sale of Riello was completed on July 1, 2026.
controles.correction_proposee: Les chiffres (46 / 815 / 414 / 592 / 170) sont exacts, mais la cession de Riello etait DEJA finalisee le 1er juillet 2026 a la date du 10-Q. Remplacer "en cours de cession" par "cede le 1er juillet 2026". Idem dans ce_qui_affaiblirait.

controles.affirmation: Les tarifs de 2025 n'avaient pas eu d'impact materiel, ce qui confirme que l'effet s'est materialise en 2026
controles.verbatim_source: To date, neither the IEEPA tariffs implemented during 2025 nor the Section 232 tariffs have had a material impact on our business
controles.correction_proposee: La societe cite les tarifs parmi les causes de baisse de marge brute ("higher input costs, including the impact of tariffs, and unfavorable business mix") mais nie explicitement, a la date du depot, tout impact materiel sur son activite. Retirer la conclusion "l'effet s'est materialise en 2026".
